name: chunk
description: Splits arrays into chunks of a given size, or groups elements by a predicate function.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to split a large array into batches for pagination, API rate-limiting, parallel processing, or grouping elements by a shared property or condition.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: The array to split into chunks.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The maximum number of elements per chunk.
